prompt: A line's availability is 0.9, performance is 0.8 and quality is 0.95. What is its OEE?

options.text: About 68%
About 88%
About 95%
About 72%

explanation: OEE is the product of availability, performance and quality: 0.9 x 0.8 x 0.95 = 0.684, about 68%. Averaging the three (about 88%) is a common mistake; 72% is A x P without quality.
verifyNote: The multiplication structure is from the Illovo source; the detailed OEE formula is marked inferred in the research.

prompt: Which AF feature makes this change quick?
scenario: Illovo Sugar tracks 49 form-fill-seal packing machines across 5 sites. Engineers want to add a new downtime-reason attribute to every machine.

options.text: Add it to the AF element template; template changes cascade to all 49 machine elements
Edit each of the 49 elements by hand
Create a new PI Data Archive for each site
Add the attribute in PI Vision only

explanation: Illovo's AF templates define the hierarchy, and template changes cascade to all 49 machine elements. That is the main reason to model machines on a template.

General Mills

prompt: Which set of figures does the Illovo Sugar success story report?

options.text: 50% improvement in performance, 25% in availability, 30% in OEE in three months
25% performance, 50% availability, 30% OEE in a year
OEE of 80%, MTBF up 180%
OEE up two percent, filling speed up ten percent

explanation: Illovo: "50% improvement in performance", "25% improvement in availability", "30% improvement in OEE in three months". OEE of 80% and MTBF +180% are Kellogg's; +2% OEE and +10% filling speed are Abbott Nutrition.

prompt: Put the CIP phases from OSIsoft's event frames demo in order.
explanation: OSIsoft's demo lists the CIP phases as pre-rinse, caustic main wash, final rinse and acid second wash, with KPIs for protocol adherence and cost/duration deviations.

prompt: What pattern does Cargill use for sites like this?
scenario: A feed mill has only a few hundred data streams and no local IT staff to run a PI Server, but head office wants its data in the central PI System.

options.text: AVEVA Edge Data Store at the site forwarding data to a central PI Server
A full PI Server collective at every feed mill
Weekly USB exports posted to head office
Leave small sites out of the PI System

explanation: Cargill's smaller sites (feed mills, grain elevators, ships, port terminals) with only a few hundred data streams use AVEVA Edge Data Store to forward data to a central PI Server.

prompt: Product overfilled beyond its declared weight is called ________.
explanation: Giveaway is product overfilled beyond declared weight. Tyson Foods reported waste and giveaway reduced by 50%.

prompt: True or false: The Tyson Foods page states its yield improvement consistently as 0.1% everywhere it appears.

options.text: True
False

explanation: False. The story reports a 0.1% yield improvement that paid back within six months, but the page metadata says ".01%", which conflicts. Quote the body figure and note the inconsistency.

prompt: What did AVEVA report for Deschutes Brewery's machine learning on PI data?

OEE of 80% and MTBF up 180%
Waste and giveaway reduced by 50%
Over 78 use cases started in one year

explanation: Deschutes: production time reduced by "up to 72 hours" per batch and "$8M" in capital upgrades eliminated. The other figures belong to Kellogg's, Tyson Foods and Coop.
